pageCache.text:
Our most recent Year 6 results were higher than the Camden average, and considerably higher than the UK national average.
Join our wonderful academic and nurturing community!
We have spaces for 2 and 3 year olds in our Acorns and Nursery. Download our application form and send it to admin@netley.camden.sch.uk
Netley Primary School Application Form EYFS
We have school tours at the following dates and times. Book a tour by emailing the school office.
School Tours 2025/26
Netley is a happy, rights respecting school.
Everyone takes steps to better themselves and their community, as they become responsible, global citizens.
Netley is a mainstream primary school that focuses on academic achievement and developing a child's curiosity and personality.
At Netley, we have high aspirations for all children. We want them to play, learn and grow into happy and confident individuals.
Our whole school big question is: Who do I want to be? We nurture children’s innate curiosity and creativity as they progress through the school. The rich curriculum ensures that our children not only make accelerated progress but prepares them for the future; careers and enterprise education is a key component in our drive for excellence.
We also are a beacon for inclusivity, and our children with special needs thrive in our centre for Autism (Woodlands) or our mainstream classrooms.
Gareth Morris (Head of School)
